purpose: broaden exact-view highlight coverage beyond the two scenes in the initial coherent corpus
source: first existing selected row per scene in natural TRAIN48 and development24, preserving split
policy: Same exact-view paired construction; scale original linear reference before rendering and quantization; never relabel development as TRAIN
acceptance: all target RGB display errors <=1 code; scene/content disjoint; >=1000 TRAIN and >=100 development highlight pixels; at least three highlight-bearing scenes in each split
limits: fixed exposure sweep of existing CC0 references, not new independent data or proof of arbitrary-look recovery
encoding_correction: v2 uses canonical storage and validates the actual saved PNG through the training loader before target construction and scoring; earlier corpus and derived trials invalidated.
